game_start: The village gates are shut. Some of you drink blood…
night_start: Darkness falls… The village closes its eyes.
night_death: The sun came up… but {{name}} will never wake again.
night_saved: A scream was heard… yet at dawn everyone was standing.
no_death: No blood was spilled tonight. For now.
day_start: The square fills up. Time to talk.
vote_hanged: The rope went taut… {{name}} is no longer part of the village.
vote_tie: The village could not decide. No one hangs… and tonight, who knows.
vote_none: Nobody voted. The rope stayed empty today.
player_left: {{name}} vanished into thin air. They left the village.
win_village: The village prevails! The last vampire is destroyed.
win_vampires: The vampires rule the village now…
spell_cast: A hum in the air… nobody hangs today.
spell_no_vote: The rope stayed empty today. Darkness is coming.
converted_self: A burn on your neck… you are one of them now.
hunter_backfire_self: Something broke in you on the hunter trail. You are an ordinary villager now.
seal_failed_hunter: Someone tried to seal you and failed. Keep your eyes open.
stole_role_self: A new life in your pocket: you are the {{role}} now.
role_stolen_self: Something was taken from you. Whatever you had is gone; you are an ordinary villager.
acted_fog_self: You brought the fog; the information roles are blind tonight.
